+<!-- Each requirement follows this structure:
+
+### REQ-### — <short title>
+- **Description:** <what is required, from the business/user perspective> ^req-###
+- **Conditions of satisfaction:**
+  - <happy path: given <state>, when <action>, then <observable outcome>>
+  - Error: when <invalid input or failure>, then <error response>
+  - Edge: when <boundary case>, then <expected behaviour>
+
+A requirement that rewords or replaces an entry `_docs/requirements.md` already
+holds says so in one line directly under its heading — one of the two, never
+both, and neither when the requirement is simply new:
+
+### REQ-### — <short title>
+- **Refines:** [REQ-NNN](../requirements.md#^req-nnn)
+- **Description:** …
+
+### REQ-### — <short title>
+- **Supersedes:** [REQ-NNN](../requirements.md#^req-nnn)
+- **Description:** …
+
+`Refines` — the existing entry keeps its number and takes this wording.
+`Supersedes` — the existing entry is retired and this requirement stands in its
+place under its own number.
+-->
+

 # Tasks — Cart
 
-> Status: ready
+<!-- The `status` property above is `draft` or `ready` — the only record on
+disk of whether the spec was reviewed. -->
 
 ## Overview
 
-Cart storage and totals on the backend, the cart page on the frontend.
+<!-- What implementing this feature involves, in two or three sentences: the
+main pieces of work and which parts of the system they touch. -->
 
 ## Tasks
 
-- [ ] **TASK-001** — Cart table and entity
-  - **Requires:** REQ-002
-  - **Type:** backend
-  - **Description:** The cart table, its entity, and the repository over it.
-
-- [ ] **TASK-002** — Cart REST endpoints
-  - **Requires:** REQ-002, REQ-003
-  - **Type:** backend
-  - **Description:** The controller over the service methods.
-
-- [ ] **TASK-003** — Cart page
-  - **Requires:** REQ-002
-  - **Type:** frontend
-  - **Description:** The page that lists what the cart holds.
-
-- [ ] **TASK-004** — Cart total display
-  - **Requires:** REQ-003
-  - **Type:** frontend
-  - **Description:** The total, refreshed whenever the cart changes.
+<!-- Each task follows this structure:
+
+- [ ] **TASK-001** — <short title>
+  - **Requires:** [REQ-001](new-requirements.md#^req-001), [REQ-003](new-requirements.md#^req-003)
+  - **Type:** backend | frontend
+  - **Description:** <what to implement, technical details, acceptance criteria>
+
+The order of the list is the order of execution. A requirement is written as a
+link to its anchor in `new-requirements.md` — the id itself stays in the link
+text, so a reader with no vault open still reads `REQ-001`.
+
+A done task is `- [x]`. A blocked task stays unchecked, keeps its ID and its
+title, and carries the reason at the end of the line:
+
+- [ ] **TASK-007** — <short title> — BLOCKED: <one-line reason>
+-->
